meaning:
ὀκταήμερος, -ον
(ὀκτώ, ἡμέρα),
of the eighth day, eight days old: with dative ref., περιτομῇ., Php.3:5 (words of this class denote duration, cf. τεταρταῖος).†
(AS)

elsewhere.note: circumcised the eighth day, of the stock of Israel, of the tribe of Benjamin, a Hebrew of Hebrews; concerning the law, a Pharisee;
